description: The voice library for character lines (voice sounds): each voice with its id, name, who it is (person: homem = man, mulher = woman, menino = boy, menina = girl), style (personagem = character, narracao = narrator), a description in the user's language, the registers it has (coloquial = loose, the default; conversa = conversational; formal = read) and sample links per register and language. Also the emotions (calmo = calm, normal, intenso = intense), the languages (pt-BR, en), the longest line (maxChars) and the price (a line is charged by its estimated seconds: characters / charsPerSecond, at least 1 s, × creditsPerSecond × versions). available=false: voice is off, do not offer it. Read-only, costs nothing. Call it before create_voice to pick the voice, register and emotion, and to quote the cost of a line.
name: list_voices
title: List voices
